# WinZor

WinZor is a marketplace platform for discovering store offers, shopping from trusted merchants, earning rewards points, and joining competitions for real prizes.

## What WinZor offers

- Marketplace: buy, sell, and browse community listings
- Offers: daily deals and promotions from partner stores
- Stores: browse and visit merchant pages
- Rewards: earn and spend points across the app
- Competitions: enter prize competitions and related win experiences

## API

API reference / backend base: https://winzor.onrender.com
